extra_notes: Hours: Tues-Thurs 12:00pm-7:00pm (closed Oct 6), Fri 3:00pm-9:00pm, Sat 10:00am-9:00pm, Sun 10:00am-8:00pm, closed Mondays. Weekday tickets do not include all activities; many activities weekend-only. Pony rides available Sat-Sun only, closes at 6:00pm. Guinea pig feeding available weekends until 6pm. Mechanical bull riding ages 5+. All ticket sales final, no refunds. Group reservations require 15+ paying individuals (children under 2 free). School field trips and birthday parties available. Thursday Family Night tickets sold at entrance only. Fire pits can be reserved.
